hypothesis: Diffusion incremental relative-return information persists after controlling for typical constituent size
source: R30 size control, original monthly panels; Historical-proxy
cohort: all F,breadth21,breadth63,size_control observed and price_ready, fixed common cohort across four methods; eras and levels separate
features: F unchanged; D=breadth21,breadth63; S=median log stock total market cap, R30 5/80 coverage
model: centered same-date ranks, train-only StandardScaler, date-balanced Ridge alpha10, no tuning
split: 2020..2026 annual expanding; >=300 rows and >=18 months; labels mature strictly before Jan1
targets: frozen excess20 primary and excess60 secondary, next-close entry
evaluation: date-equal MSE and Rank IC >=5 complete industries; annual stability; main increment FDS-FS compared to FD-F on same cohort; all results retained
uncertainty: primary five era/level comparisons; simultaneous 99% normal-reference HAC intervals (Bonferroni five at 5%), lag3 for20, lag6 for60; descriptive not proof with short samples; no independent-date assumption
stop: no parameter search or portfolio optimization on absent increment; not a full style model, not causal or live validation
